consequence.statement: The `pilot.enabled` configuration value will no longer be honored in the `istiod-remote` and `istio-discovery` charts if it was previously set.

original.statement: The helm-value `pilot.enabled` has been removed from the `istiod-remote` and `istio-discovery` charts.

decision.reason: [ev-f8e584b7eab2] says `pilot.enabled` was removed from the `istiod-remote` and `istio-discovery` charts. A chart values key that has been removed fits the setting-ignored kind ("removed/renamed key"): a value an operator sets is no longer honoured. The same section treats other removed values keys as having no effect [ev-c6870d2efa84], so the proposed setting-ignored consequence with medium severity holds. The evidence does not say what the key used to control, so the size of the impact is inferred, which is why confidence is low.
